open_points.subject: sandbox.execute_function result and stop propagation
open_points.text: “sandbox reports that outcome with SandboxResult.stop_required true” conflicts with “an unconfirmed cleanup is the result crashed with detail cleanup_failed; the caller writes the record and returns stop_required”; the sandbox.execute_function Outputs section does not include stop_required.
open_points.question: Does sandbox.execute_function return a SandboxResult containing stop_required, or does its caller infer and create a separate stop_required result after seeing crashed/cleanup_failed; and, if it is a field, is it always present or present only when true?
options: SandboxResult always has a boolean stop_required
SandboxResult has an optional stop_required present only when true
SandboxResult has no stop_required field; callers infer a separate stop_required result from crashed/cleanup_failed
open_points.default_guess: SandboxResult always has a boolean stop_required, false normally and true for unconfirmed cleanup; callers propagate that flag after recording the execution.
